sources.title: Throated Krea2 - Throated Krea2 v1.0 | Krea 2 LoRA | Civitai
sources.snippet: Throated is a concept LoRA for Krea2 that teaches the model one thing: deepthroat blowjobs that look natural, with believable depth, mouth shape and body position. It was trained on 128 photos real photos, shot from many angles, in many rooms and lighting setups, and with a wide range of women.
